thread:
ashley: FYI DAST raised a HIGH open-redirect in payments-ui on the staging deploy. Screenshot attached by scan-bot. Can someone take a quick look?
scan-bot: [auto] DAST report: payments-ui /redirect?to=<external> -> open redirect detected. Evidence: 302 to attacker-controlled host. Scan id: dast/2026-03-22/stg-5591
maria: Ack. Sam, can you reproduce against staging from your laptop? We need to confirm before filing a vuln ticket.
sam: Trying `curl -I 'https://staging.payments.redwood.internal/redirect?to=https://evil.example'` and I'm getting a 403 from the ingress, not a 302. 
ashley: That's weird. The DAST runner is inside the CI cluster though — maybe different egress path or headers.
devops-bot: Note: Envoy filter "remove-xfp-and-legacy" was deployed in staging at 2026-03-21T23:58Z (PR #3120). Creator: platform-team.
maria: Could that change alter redirect behavior?
kevin: Possibly. That filter rewrites/sanitizes forwarded headers. Also platform rolled mTLS certs to egress gateway the same night. The scanner runs as a k8s job that relies on a signed snapshot of the site assets fetched from GCS using KMS-signed URLs. If the scanner falls back to cached snapshot, HTML might be older or truncated and produce false positives.
ashley: Wait — are we sure the scanner fetched the live page? The DAST config uses prefetch artifact verification. If KMS-signature verification fails, it will continue with the local cache and still run.
sam: Good call. I see `Prefetch artifact signature verification: FAILED (KMS: PERMISSION_DENIED)` in the job log.
scan-bot: [auto] Prefetch step: `gcs://ci-artifacts/dast/staging/2026-03-22/site-snapshot.tar.gz` -> signature verify failed.
maria: That would explain mismatch. Why did KMS deny? Any RBAC changes?
kevin: We recently tightened the KMS IAM policy to remove wide decrypter bindings from compute service accounts; as part of that I tightened the key ring bindings and accidentally left out the CI scanner SA. Running: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/dast-keys/cryptoKeys/snapshot-signer` shows no entry for `scanner@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
ashley: Oof. So the scanner fell back to cached snapshot that still had a redirect 302 for an old dev redirector.
sam: I can confirm reproducer: after downloading the live snapshot manually with an account that can decrypt, `curl -I` against the live HTML returns 200 and no redirect.
maria: Action plan: (1) temporarily grant KMS decrypt to scanner SA, (2) re-run DAST job against live artifact, (3) if result is gone mark finding as FALSE_POSITIVE, else open vuln ticket. Also add a rotation preflight to ensure scanner SA has decrypt permission.
kevin: I'll add a temp binding with TTL 1h: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/dast-keys/cryptoKeys/snapshot-signer --member=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
oncall-bot: Incident created: #sec-incident-2026-03-22-5591. Pager notified. Runbook ref: sdlc-011.
kevin: Grant applied. Also adding storage.list/get for the scanner SA: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-ci --member=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectViewer`
scan-bot: [auto] Re-run queued: dast/2026-03-22/stg-5591-rerun. ETA 7m.
ashley: While we wait, two follow-ups: (A) platform team should confirm the envoy filter behavior and whether it can be scoped to not affect CI scanner requests; (B) security should add a post-rotation test that attempts KMS decrypt using the scanner SA as a gate in the key rotation pipeline.
maria: Agreed. Sam, please take the envoy reproduce and open a small platform issue if the filter is the cause. Sam: assign to platform.
sam: Will do. Reproducer steps I'll paste in the issue: `kubectl port-forward svc/ingress-staging 8080:80 && curl -v -H 'Host: staging.payments.redwood.internal' http://localhost:8080/redirect?to=https://evil.example` -> shows header X-Forwarded-Proto missing and 302 behaviour when run from cluster node IP.
scan-bot: [auto] Re-run finished. Result: NO_MORE_ISSUES — open-redirect not observed on live artifact. Confidence: high.
maria: Marking original finding as FALSE_POSITIVE due to artifact verification failure. Still opening a short ticket sdlc-319 to: (1) add KMS preflight check in rotation-pipeline (assigned kevin), (2) add DAST job preflight which fails job on signature-verify error (assigned ashley), (3) platform issue to scope envoy filter (assigned platform-team).
kevin: I'll make the KMS preflight PR and add an alert if scanner SA loses decrypt privileges.
ashley: I'll update DAST job config to fail hard on signature verify fail and add a doc blurb in runbook SDLC-DAST about treating prefetched artifacts as authoritative only if signature verification passes.
maria: Good. Closing the incident once PRs merged + platform triage. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
